offerings.name: Search
offerings.pricing: Hobby: $19/month billed monthly, or $16/month billed annually, for 5,000 credits per month (2,500 searches or 5,000 pages scraped). Search costs 2 credits per 10 results.
offerings.free_quota: 1,000 credits / month；500 searches or 1,000 pages scraped
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果；返回 titles、descriptions 和 URLs，可选抓取每个结果的 markdown、HTML、links 或 screenshots
offerings.note: 搜索结果默认包含 query-relevant Highlights；搜索费用按每 10 个结果 2 credits，向上取整。
